prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” roofing company in Dallas — the right contractor depends on your needs (shingle type, budget, warranty required, insurance claim or private pay, emergency timeline, etc.). I can find and recommend top local roofers for your exact situation, but first here’s how to pick the best one and what I need from you to give specific names.

What to look for in a Dallas roof replacement contractor
- Local experience and permanence: established Dallas-based presence and verifiable local references.
- Manufacturer certifications: GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred, etc. These affect warranty options.
- Insurance and bonding: general liability and—if required in your area—worker’s comp. Ask for certificates.
- Written estimate and scope: material, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, deck repairs, cleanup, permit pull, timeline, and payment schedule.
- Warranty clarity: manufacturer warranty (shingles) plus a workmanship/installation warranty from the contractor; get both in writing.
- Permits and inspections: contractor should pull local permits and arrange final inspections.
- Positive, recent reviews: Google, Yelp, BBB, and local references. Beware companies that pop up only after storms (“storm chasers”).
- Transparent payment terms: avoid contractors demanding large full upfront payments; use a reasonable deposit and lien waivers with final payment.
- Cleanup and lien waiver: insist on a written cleanup plan and a lien release when final payment is made.

Red flags
- High-pressure sales tactics or door-to-door storm solicitors
- No physical Dallas address or only a P.O. box
- Refusal to provide proof of insurance or references
- Extremely low bid that’s much lower than other estimates

If you want company recommendations
Tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood) and any priorities (insurance claim, budget, shingle brand preference, timeline). I’ll find 3–5 highly rated, certified Dallas-area roofers, summarize their credentials, and point out which is likely the best match for your situation.
